options.name: azure_credential
options.description: The name of the SQL Server credential to be used if restoring from an Azure hosted backup using Storage Access Keys.

options.name: block_size
options.description: Specifies block size to use.

options.name: buffer_count
options.description: Number of I/O buffers to use.

options.name: database
options.description: The database to process.

options.name: destination_data_directory
options.description: Path to restore the SQL Server backups to on the target instance. If only this option is specified, then all database files (data and log) will be restored to this location

options.name: destination_file_prefix
options.description: This value will be prefixed to B(all) restored files (log and data).

options.name: destination_file_suffix
options.description: This value will be suffixed to B(all) restored files (log and data).

options.name: destination_filestream_directory
options.description: Path to restore FileStream data to. This option can only be specified alongside I(destination_data_directory).

options.name: destination_log_directory
options.description: Path to restore the database log files to. This option can only be specified alongside I(destination_data_directory).

options.name: directory_recurse
options.description: If specified the specified directory will be recursed into (overriding the default behaviour).

options.name: ignore_diff_backup
options.description: Indicates to skip restoring any differential backups.

options.name: ignore_log_backup
options.description: Indicates to skip restoring any log backups.

options.name: keep_cdc
options.description: Indicates whether CDC information should be restored as part of the database.

options.name: keep_replication
options.description: Indicates whether replication configuration should be restored as part of the database restore operation.

options.name: maintenance_solution_backup
options.description: Switch to indicate the backup files are in a folder structure as created by Ola Hallengreen's maintenance scripts. This allows for faster file parsing.

options.name: max_transfer_size
options.description: Sets the size of the unit of transfer. Values must be a multiple of 64kb.

options.name: no_recovery
options.description: Indicates if the databases should be recovered after last restore.

options.name: no_xp_dir_recurse
options.description: If specified, prevents the C(XpDirTree) process from recursing (its default behaviour).

options.name: path
options.description: Path to SQL Server backup files. Paths passed in as strings will be scanned using the desired method, default is a recursive folder scan. Accepts multiple paths separated by C(,).

options.name: replace_db_name_in_file
options.description: If switch set any occurrence of the original database's name in a data or log file will be replace with the name specified in the I(database_name) option.

options.name: restore_time
options.description: Specify a datetime string C(HH:MM:SS MM/DD/YYYY) to which you want the database restored to. Default is to the latest point available in the specified backups.

options.name: restored_database_name_prefix
options.description: A string which will be prefixed to the start of the restore Database's name.

options.name: reuse_source_folder_structure
options.description: By default, databases will be migrated to the destination Sql Server's default data and log directories. You can override this by using C(reuse_source_folder_structure).

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: sql_password
options.description: Password for SQL Authentication.

options.name: sql_username
options.description: Username for SQL Authentication.

options.name: standby_directory
options.description: If a directory is specified the database(s) will be restored into a standby state, with the standby file placed into this directory (which must exist, and be writable by the target Sql Server instance).

options.name: stop_after_date
options.description: By default the restore will stop at the first occurence of I(stop_mark) found in the chain, passing a datetime string C(HH:MM:SS MM/DD/YYYY) will cause it to stop the first I(stop_mark) after that datetime.

options.name: stop_before
options.description: Switch to indicate the restore should stop before I(stop_mark) occurs, default is to stop when mark is created.

options.name: stop_mark
options.description: Marked point in the transaction log to stop the restore at.

options.name: use_destination_default_directories
options.description: Switch that tells the restore to use the default Data and Log locations on the target server. If they don't exist, the function will try to create them.

options.name: verify_only
options.description: Indicates the restore should be verified only.

options.name: with_replace
options.description: Indicates if the restore is allowed to replace an existing database.

options.name: xp_dirtree
options.description: Switch that indicated file scanning should be performed by the SQL Server instance using C(xp_dirtree). This will scan recursively from the passed in path. You must have sysadmin role membership on the instance for this to work.
